Getting Started

Warden is a lightweight, single-binary Linux server management panel. It provides a web interface for common server administration tasks without the overhead of large management suites.

Sudo Mode: Many operations require elevated privileges. Use the sudo toggle in the header to enable sudo mode. When active, commands will be executed with sudo.
Theme: Click the sun/moon icon in the header to switch between dark and light themes. Your preference is saved automatically.
Right-Click Menus: Most tables support right-click context menus for quick actions on rows.

Feature Guide

Dashboard

Real-time overview of CPU, memory, disk, and network usage with boundary tabs for Deployments, Customers, Warden Internal, and Connections. Includes topology and auto-refresh.

Deployments

Template-driven rollout workflow with subtabs for Active, Pending/Rollouts, Backups, Recovery Drills, and Migrations, plus Environment/Substrate/Cluster/Tenant metadata.

Services

Manage systemd units. Start, stop, restart, enable, or disable services. Filter units by name. Sortable columns for easy navigation.

Packages

View installed packages, check for updates, and install/remove packages. Supports APT and Snap package managers with a progress overlay for operations.

Docker

Manage Docker containers, images, volumes, and networks. Start, stop, restart, or remove containers. Pull new images and view container logs.

Files

Browse the filesystem, view and edit text files, create files and directories, rename, delete, and download files. Supports path navigation and breadcrumbs.

Logs

View system logs via journalctl. Filter by unit, priority level, and time range. Supports keyword search and auto-follow for live log streaming.

Cron

Manage cron jobs for any user. Add, edit, or delete scheduled tasks. Includes preset schedules and a human-readable preview of cron expressions.

Users & Groups

Manage system users and groups. Create, edit, and delete users. Change passwords, lock/unlock accounts, and manage group memberships.

Firewall

Manage UFW firewall rules. Enable/disable the firewall, add or delete rules with presets for common services (SSH, HTTP, HTTPS). View all active rules.

Terminal

Full interactive terminal via WebSocket. Runs as the logged-in system user with proper PTY support. Supports terminal resizing.

System

Reboot, shutdown, or schedule system power actions. Requires sudo mode to be enabled for safety.

About

Warden is a lightweight, self-contained Linux server management panel built with Go. It compiles to a single binary with all templates, styles, and assets embedded — no external dependencies, no database, no configuration files required.

Designed for developers and sysadmins who want a clean, modern web interface for routine server tasks without the complexity of heavyweight management suites.
